changes: Hide torch::jit::Module behind a unique_ptr with an out-of-line destructor to isolate torch/script.h from shared adapters.
Replace torch/torch.h with specific autograd, gradient-mode, tensor and archive headers.

method.profile: dev; C++ debug information disabled by default
method.measurement_limitations: Single-run wall times on a shared development machine; not statistical guarantees. max_rss_kib is the maximum RSS reported by GNU time, not aggregate simultaneous process memory. Fresh target builds still use downloaded SDKs and cached Cargo registry sources.

cuda_native_rebuild.scope: All native C++ adapters rebuilt with existing Rust dependencies retained.

baseline.scope: All native C++ adapters rebuilt after build.rs changed; existing Cargo target and Rust dependencies retained. This is not an empty-Cargo-cache measurement.

cpu_fresh_target_build.scope: cargo build --offline --manifest-path native/rust/Cargo.toml --bin native-boundary-helper with an empty CARGO_TARGET_DIR, including Rust dependencies. This differs from the CUDA rebuild scope and is not a before/after comparison.

regression_coverage: TorchScript forward and disposal, optional/list tensor ownership, Adam and SGD checkpoint restoration, autograd, and CUDA. New test checks that TorchScript output outlives disposed model and input. CPU run excludes the ten CUDA tests.
remaining_cost: Cold helper construction still requires substantial memory. Reuse or prebuild helpers for latency-sensitive consumers.
